sources.title: 國內掀搶蛋之亂 廠商示警：蛋價恐回不去了！
sources.effective_period: Contemporaneous conditions described around the 2022 Lunar New Year; no formal measurement window stated.
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning「業者指出，台灣每天的雞蛋需求量大約是2200萬顆」
sources.note: Reports 卜蜂's share as about 5% in the context of Taiwan's egg market and daily demand of about 22 million eggs. The estimate is attributed to unnamed industry participants; the article does not provide a numerator or share-calculation method.

sources.title: 蛋價上漲又缺蛋，卜蜂與大成受惠解析！
sources.effective_period: Described as current in the article published 2023-02-25; no formal measurement window stated.
sources.locator: Section「蛋品新增產線將全部投產－卜蜂」
sources.note: An investment blogger states that 卜蜂's egg-product market share is about 5%, without citing a source or defining the calculation denominator.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches located contemporaneous secondary reports supporting a Taiwan egg-market interpretation, but no official primary disclosure or defined share methodology. Further searching was stopped with the original market scope and denominator unresolved.
No official issuer or regulator source located in this research established the approximately 5% figure.
The 2022 report attributes the estimate to unnamed industry participants; the 2023 blog gives no citation for it.
The reported daily egg demand provides context, not a verified denominator for the market-share calculation.
